messages.subject: Re: converting factors into dates
messages.body_plain:
Elisabeth,

ymd can only handle vector input. It looks like date is a data frame. You'll need to pass just the DurationPartner_1 column of date to ymd.

You can extract this column as vector with

date$DurationPartner_1

and parse it with

ymd(date$DurationPartner_1)

Cheers,
Garrett

On Thu, May 8, 2014 at 2:37 AM, Elisabeth Schubach <elisabeth...@gmx.de> wrote:
> Dear lubridate-users,
>
> I am new to lubridate and tried to convert factors into dates using the following command. However, I got the following error message:
> > ymd(date)
> [1] NA.
> Warning message:
> All formats failed to parse. No formats found.
> > str(date)
> 'data.frame': 1819 obs. of  1 variable:
>  $ DurationPartner_1: Factor w/ 147 levels "","0000-00-00",..: 104 1 1 78 131 1 135 79 68 108 ...
>
> I would appreciate your help.
>
> Elisabeth
